story_info.title: Penny Penguin's Polite Picnic
story_info.subtitle: Sharing with good manners
story_info.moral: Good manners make friends happy and every day fun!

main_character.name: Penny Penguin
main_character.appearance: Penny is a small round penguin with glossy black-and-white feathers, a bright orange beak, and orange webbed feet. She has rosy cheeks and a cheerful, energetic stance.

supporting_characters.name: Squeaky Squirrel
supporting_characters.appearance: A small brown squirrel with a bushy tail, bright eyes, and tiny paws.
supporting_characters.role: A friend Penny helps with good manners and sharing.

slides.title: A Sunny Morning
slides.text: Penny Penguin woke up early. The sun shone bright over Snowy Shores. "Healthy habits make every day fun!" she chirped. She packed her basket. It had yummy berry tarts and fresh fruit. Penny wanted to have a picnic. She thought of Blossom Meadow.
slides.speaker_notes: Introduce Penny and her morning routine, showing her healthy habits and plans for a picnic.

slides.title: A Sad Friend
slides.text: Penny walked cheerfully to Blossom Meadow. The colourful flowers swayed hello. She saw a little squirrel. It was Squeaky Squirrel. Squeaky looked very sad. His small basket was empty. He had dropped all his acorns on the path.
slides.speaker_notes: Penny meets Squeaky, who is upset because he lost his food. This sets up the small challenge.

slides.title: A Kind Offer
slides.text: "Hello, Squeaky," Penny said with a kind smile. "Are you alright?" Squeaky looked up slowly. "I dropped my breakfast," he mumbled. Penny felt a warm feeling. She remembered her healthy snacks. "Would you like to share with me, please?" she asked him.
slides.speaker_notes: Penny shows empathy and uses polite language to offer help, introducing the learning goal of good manners.

slides.title: Sharing and Saying Thank You
slides.text: Squeaky's eyes got big. "Really? Thank you, Penny!" he said. Penny carefully opened her basket. She offered Squeaky a juicy berry. Squeaky took it gently. "This is very kind of you," Squeaky said. Penny felt happy sharing her treats.
slides.speaker_notes: Squeaky accepts politely and thanks Penny, reinforcing the concept of manners and mutual respect.

slides.title: Happy Hearts
slides.text: They sat together in the meadow. They ate the tasty fruit and tarts. Squeaky learned to say "please" and "thank you" too. Good manners made their picnic super fun! Penny knew sharing and being polite made everyone feel good inside.
slides.speaker_notes: The story ends with a happy picnic, highlighting the positive impact of good manners and how it makes everyone feel happy and calm.
